newsitem.title: FRANCE: Renault targets car operation breakeven.
newsitem.headline: Renault targets car operation breakeven.

text.p: Renault chairman Louis Schweitzer said on Tuesday that the group continued to target breakeven for its car operations.

"Despite a greater than expected deterioration in the French market, a return to breakeven for the car division remains a reasonably accessible objective for 1997," he told the company's annual general meeting.
"Under these conditions, at the group level, the net and operating results would be positive," he said.
Schweitzer said foreign exchange movements, notably the dollar's performance in recent months, was positive for export revenue.

He said that the western European car market was expected to be slightly higher this year but the French car market was expected to fall more than 10 percent from 1996 levels to around 1.85 million cars.
